definitions: to be completely engrossed in watching a screen (television, computer, phone, etc.)
to spend an excessive amount of time looking at a screen
examples: The kids were glued to the screen all weekend playing video games.
She's been glued to the screen watching that new series.
I was glued to the screen during the entire movie.
lemma: to be glued to the screen
synonyms: to be riveted to the screen
to be transfixed by the screen
to be absorbed by the screen
source: to be glued to the screen
